hook: Superhuman strength equal to 20 strong men defines Count Dracula, but can Sherlock Holmes outthink him?

sections.voiceover: Superhuman strength equal to 20 strong men defines Count Dracula, but can Sherlock Holmes outthink him?
sections.visual_cue: Side-by-side silhouette comparison of a detective and a vampire.

sections.voiceover: In Bram Stoker's original text, the Count displays terrifying, superhuman physical power. Author Loren D. Estleman explored this vampire encounter in his 1978 novel, Sherlock Holmes vs. Dracula. How does the detective survive such force?
sections.visual_cue: Old parchment background with 18th-century ink drawings.

sections.voiceover: Author Christian Klaver raises the stakes in his 2022 book, Sherlock Holmes and Dracula.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a modern book cover design.

sections.voiceover: Penguin Random House published this intense investigation across 432 pages on October 11, 2022.
sections.visual_cue: Magnifying glass hovering over a dense wall of text.

sections.voiceover: Dracula possesses the physical strength of 20 strong men, challenging the detective's legendary deductive skills.
sections.visual_cue: A single candle flame flickering in the dark.
